about: Every place the mod touches The Long Drive. No Harmony patches: the mod finds objects at runtime. Each row becomes one TldHook lookup.

rows.what_mod_does: parent for first-person gorilla hands; head position for arm reach
rows.verified: yes: creator's logs; The Long Drive keeps MenuCam alive in game, so Camera.main alone flips to the menu camera

rows.how_found: Camera.main.transform.root, must carry a CharacterController or non-kinematic Rigidbody
rows.verified: yes: creator's log, root Player(Clone), walk script fpscontroller

rows.what_mod_does: disabled while gorilla mode is on, re-enabled when off or seated
rows.if_not_found: gorilla mode still runs; WASD may fight it; log once
rows.verified: yes: creator's log, root Player(Clone), walk script fpscontroller
